tools.name: split_costs
tools.description: Split one total court or venue cost across players, equally or by relative weights, and show each player's share plus the fewest payments to settle up. Use for a single booking or event. For recurring sessions with changing attendance use split_series.

tools.name: settle_up
tools.description: Given a shared total and who already paid what, compute each player's balance and the minimal set of payments (who pays whom, how much) to settle everyone. Use when the question is 'who owes whom'. For recurring sessions with different attendees use split_series.

tools.name: split_series
tools.description: Split a series of recurring sessions where attendance varies: each session's cost is shared only by that session's attendees, then payments already made are netted into balances and minimal settle-up transfers. Use for weekly games or leagues. For a single event use split_costs.

tools.name: rotation_plan
tools.description: Plan fair player rotations for pickup games: who plays on each court every round and who sits out, balancing games played across the roster. Use when more players show up than court spots. Does not split money; for costs use split_costs or split_series.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "split_costs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
